_note: Задание для генерации. stage: images — только картинки сцен (центы); video — оживить выбранные сцены (дороже).
style: Cinematic stylized 3D animated film look, soft warm golden-hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, gentle realistic textures, like the attached style reference. Sunny green city park with a children's playground (wooden swings, a slide, sand), trees, a few blurred people far in the background. IMPORTANT: every person has NO face at all: the face area is a smooth solid deep-black shadow, no eyes, no nose, no mouth, no skin visible on the face. Hands are in dark gloves or hidden in sleeves. No text, no letters, no logos, no toys or plush animals. 16:9 wide frame.
characters: Two boys about 8 years old. AHMAD: navy-blue zip jacket, dark-blue knitted beanie hat, grey trousers, white sneakers, small brown backpack. OMAR: olive-green hooded jacket with the hood up, light-grey trousers, dark boots. Both faces are pure black featureless shadow.

scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the playground. OMAR sits alone on a wooden swing on the right. AHMAD walks in from the left along the path toward him.
Medium shot: AHMAD stands in front of the swing and raises his right hand in a friendly greeting. OMAR on the swing turns toward him.
Medium two-shot from the side: both boys stand facing each other next to the swings, relaxed, friendly body language.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind OMAR (his olive hood in the foreground, out of focus) looking at AHMAD, who points to himself with his gloved hand.
Reverse over-the-shoulder shot from behind AHMAD (his navy beanie in the foreground, out of focus) looking at OMAR, who places his gloved hand on his chest.
Low-angle two-shot near the slide: both boys standing and talking, the slide and trees behind them, warm sunlight.
Medium shot: the two boys shake hands warmly in the middle of the playground, happy friendly mood.
